notes: words counts differing 4-byte instruction words; the six raw sites are relocation-symbol naming differences (section-symbol+addend vs named-symbol+0) that resolve identically at link time.

Against a target whose .rodata is truncated at the jump tables (see docs/target-rodata-defect.md), a hosted comparison charges the function's own 20-byte literal pool as a score of 5; against a correctly scoped target the score is 0.
